items.title: Native Solana test-network acceptance (Block A)
items.blockedReason: Waiting for the two-day governance time lock on the approved proposals. Program initialization can execute no earlier than 2026-10-27 15:05:04 UTC and oracle registration no earlier than 2026-10-27 15:05:22 UTC, judged on the network's own clock with no shortcut. This clears when those times pass. No activation of Internet Computer services or real rewards is part of this work.
items.nextAction: Once the deadlines pass: execute program initialization (the sponsor co-signs), then oracle registration, then the read-back checks, then start the 39-step acceptance flow plan.
